statement: The unified dashboard is a query-backed set of Overview, Transactions, Journal, Balance Sheet, Income Statement, and Commodities projections over the included Beancount text ledger.

Structured routing maps accounts, commodities, prices, pads, balances, queries, notes, events, and date-derived transactions to canonical generated files, while the modal supports only a subset of those directive writes.

The persisted setting schema controls executable paths, limits, dashboard period, structured layout, pricing, backups, editor features, and onboarding; writer success still requires an external bean-check and include-graph verification.
